name: ANSI/IEEE triac symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for triac, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The TRIAC form identifies a controlled bidirectional semiconductor path. Its main-terminal and gate references establish how the drive circuit is related to the AC load circuit, with operating details supplied by the selected component.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Use the component's main-terminal numbering to resolve the gate reference.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A TRIAC has a gate-controlled function unlike a DIAC triggering element.
